senses.en: A group of things that go together.
senses.zh: 一套；一副；一串（成套物品）

ex.en: I have a set of keys.
ex.zh: 我有一串钥匙。

ex.en: He bought a set of books.
ex.zh: 他买了一套书。

tip: a set of 后接复数名词。

senses.en: A girl's name.

ex.en: Anna is my good friend.
ex.zh: 安娜是我的好朋友。

ex.en: Anna, is this your model plane?
ex.zh: 安娜，这是你的飞机模型吗？

senses.en: A boy's name.

ex.en: John is in my class.
ex.zh: 约翰和我同班。

ex.en: John has a model plane.
ex.zh: 约翰有一架飞机模型。

tip: John 是英语国家最常见的男子名之一。

senses.en: A boy's name.

ex.en: David is Anna's brother.
ex.zh: 大卫是安娜的哥哥。

ex.en: David, where is my tape player?
ex.zh: 大卫，我的录音机在哪儿？

senses.en: In or to what place.

ex.en: Where is my schoolbag?
ex.zh: 我的书包在哪里？

ex.en: Where are my keys?
ex.zh: 我的钥匙在哪里？

tip: 问单个物品用 Where is ...?，多个用 Where are ...?

senses.en: a piece of furniture with a flat top and legs
information arranged in rows and columns

ex.en: We gathered around the table to share fresh bread.
ex.zh: 我们围坐在桌边，一起吃新鲜面包。

ex.en: The table compares average household spending on transport in three cities over a ten-year period.
ex.zh: 该表比较了三个城市十年间的家庭平均交通支出。

tip: set the table指摆餐具，不是摆放桌子。

senses.en: A piece of furniture used for sleeping
The ground at the bottom of a river, sea, or lake
An area of soil prepared for growing plants

ex.en: The cat curled up on my bed after lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭后，猫蜷缩在我的床上。

ex.en: Maintaining a regular time to go to bed can improve sleep quality and support mental health.
ex.zh: 保持固定的就寝时间可以改善睡眠质量，并有益于心理健康。

tip: go to bed指就寝，不加the；make the bed指铺床。

senses.en: A piece of furniture with shelves for books.

ex.en: She keeps her favourite novels in a wooden bookcase.
ex.zh: 她把最喜欢的小说放在一个木书柜里。

ex.en: Placing accessible bookcases in classrooms can encourage children to read independently during their free time.
ex.zh: 在教室里摆放方便取书的书柜，可以鼓励孩子在空闲时间自主阅读。

col: a bookcase full of books｜装满书的书柜
tip: bookcase指整件书柜，bookshelf指书架或一层搁板。

senses.en: A soft seat with a back for several people

ex.en: We curled up on the sofa after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后，我们蜷坐在沙发上。

ex.en: A comfortable sofa in a shared lounge can encourage residents to spend more time together.
ex.zh: 公共休息室里一张舒适的沙发可以鼓励住户多聚在一起。

col: sit on the sofa｜坐在沙发上
tip: 坐在沙发上用on the sofa，不用in。

senses.en: a seat for one person, usually with a back
the person responsible for leading a meeting or committee
to lead a meeting and manage its discussion

ex.en: She pulled a chair closer to the window.
ex.zh: 她把一把椅子拉到离窗户更近的地方。

ex.en: An independent expert should chair the meeting to ensure that all participants can contribute fairly.
ex.zh: 应由一位独立专家主持会议，确保所有参与者都能公平地发表意见。

tip: chair作动词直接接meeting，表示主持会议。

senses.en: Touching and supported by a surface.
Used for days and dates, or to introduce a topic.
Operating or receiving power.

ex.en: Your keys are on the table beside the door.
ex.zh: 你的钥匙在门旁的桌子上。

ex.en: Installing solar panels on public buildings can reduce energy costs and demonstrate a government's commitment to sustainability.
ex.zh: 在公共建筑上安装太阳能板可以降低能源成本，并展现政府对可持续发展的重视。

col: a report on education｜一份关于教育的报告
tip: 具体某天用on；月份用in；钟点用at。

senses.en: in or into a position below something
less than a particular amount, age, or level
experiencing a condition or being controlled by someone or something

ex.en: The cat curled up under the kitchen table.
ex.zh: 猫蜷缩在厨房的桌子下面。

ex.en: Under the new policy, local authorities must provide safer cycling routes near schools and residential areas.
ex.zh: 根据新政策，地方政府必须在学校和住宅区附近提供更安全的骑行路线。

col: under the age of｜年龄不满
tip: under可表位置、数量或状态：under pressure。

senses.en: Move towards the speaker or a particular place.
Arrive in time or happen.
Have a particular origin or source.

ex.en: Come inside and warm your hands by the fire.
ex.zh: 进来在火边暖暖手吧。

ex.en: Much of the funding for public libraries comes from local government rather than private donations.
ex.zh: 公共图书馆的大部分资金来自地方政府，而非私人捐赠。

tip: 不规则变化：come–came–come；come from表示来自。

senses.en: Used to hurry or encourage somebody.

ex.en: Come on, Jack! You can do it.
ex.zh: 加油，杰克！你能行。

ex.en: Come on! We're late.
ex.zh: 快点！我们要迟到了。

senses.en: A table used for studying, writing, or office work
A counter where people receive information or services

ex.en: I keep my pencils in the top desk drawer.
ex.zh: 我把铅笔放在书桌最上面的抽屉里。

ex.en: Providing every student with a suitable desk can improve comfort and concentration in the classroom.
ex.zh: 为每位学生提供合适的课桌可以提高课堂上的舒适度和专注度。

col: sit at a desk｜坐在书桌前
tip: 在书桌前用at a desk，不用on a desk。

senses.en: To have an opinion or belief about something.
To use your mind to consider ideas or solve problems.

ex.en: I think this soup needs a little more salt.
ex.zh: 我觉得这汤需要再加一点盐。

ex.en: Some people think that schools should devote more time to practical skills rather than examination preparation.
ex.zh: 一些人认为，学校应将更多时间用于实用技能，而不是备考。

tip: 过去式、过去分词均为thought；认为时通常不用进行时。

senses.en: A part of a building separated by walls and doors.
Available space or opportunity for something.

ex.en: My room has a desk beside the window.
ex.zh: 我的房间里，窗边有一张书桌。

ex.en: Although public transport has improved significantly, there is still room for further investment in rural services.
ex.zh: 尽管公共交通已显著改善，农村交通服务仍有进一步投资的空间。

tip: 指房间时可数；指空间或余地时不可数。

senses.en: Belonging to them.

ex.en: Their classroom is big.
ex.zh: 他们的教室很大。

ex.en: Their books are on the desk.
ex.zh: 他们的书在课桌上。

tip: their 是形容词性物主代词，后面必须接名词。

senses.en: a covering worn on the head for protection or decoration

ex.en: I grabbed my hat before stepping into the sunshine.
ex.zh: 走到阳光下之前，我拿起了帽子。

ex.en: Wearing a wide-brimmed hat can reduce sun exposure, particularly for people who spend long hours working outdoors.
ex.zh: 戴宽檐帽可以减少日晒，对长时间在户外工作的人尤其有用。

tip: 戴着帽子用wear；戴上帽子的动作用put on。

senses.en: the body part containing the brain, eyes, and mouth
the person in charge of a group or organisation
to move or travel in a particular direction

ex.en: She shook her head when I offered more soup.
ex.zh: 我问她要不要再来点汤，她摇了摇头。

ex.en: Cyclists should wear suitable helmets to reduce the risk of head injuries when travelling on busy roads.
ex.zh: 骑车人在繁忙道路上行驶时应佩戴合适的头盔，以降低头部受伤的风险。

tip: head for＋地点表示“朝某地去”。

senses.en: Yes, in informal speech.

ex.en: Do you like it? — Yeah!
ex.zh: 你喜欢它吗？——嗯，喜欢！

ex.en: Yeah, that's right.
ex.zh: 对，就是这样。

tip: yeah 是口语说法，正式写作中请用 yes。

senses.en: To have information or understanding about something
To be familiar with a person, place, or thing

ex.en: Do you know how to fix this bicycle?
ex.zh: 你知道怎么修这辆自行车吗？

ex.en: Consumers need to know how their personal information is collected before they can make informed choices online.
ex.zh: 消费者需要了解个人信息的收集方式，才能在网上作出知情选择。

tip: 过去式knew，过去分词known；通常不用进行时。

senses.en: a device used to receive and play broadcast sound

senses.zh: 无线电广播；无线电通信
senses.en: broadcasting or communication using electromagnetic waves
to contact someone or send information using radio equipment

ex.en: Dad keeps a small radio on the kitchen shelf.
ex.zh: 爸爸在厨房架子上放着一台小收音机。

ex.en: Radio remains an important source of information in remote communities where reliable internet access is limited.
ex.zh: 在难以稳定上网的偏远社区，广播仍是重要的信息来源。

tip: 听广播常说listen to the radio；在广播中用on the radio。

senses.en: a device that shows the time
to measure or record the time or speed of something

ex.en: The kitchen clock stopped while we were making lunch.
ex.zh: 我们做午饭时，厨房的时钟停了。

ex.en: Flexible working arrangements allow employees to work when they are most productive, rather than watching the clock.
ex.zh: 弹性工作安排让员工在效率最高时工作，而不是盯着时钟等下班。

col: watch the clock｜盯着时间等下班
tip: clock通常指钟；戴在手腕上的表叫watch。

senses.en: A narrow sticky strip used to attach or seal things.
A magnetic strip used to record sound, images, or data.
Attach or secure something using sticky tape.

ex.en: I sealed the parcel with a strip of tape.
ex.zh: 我用一条胶带封好了包裹。

ex.en: Older interviews stored on magnetic tape should be digitised to preserve valuable records for future historical research.
ex.zh: 保存在磁带上的早期访谈应进行数字化处理，为未来的历史研究保存珍贵记录。

col: a roll of tape｜一卷胶带
tip: 胶带通常不可数；一卷胶带说a roll of tape。

senses.en: someone who takes part in a sport or game
someone who plays a musical instrument
a device or program that plays recorded sound or video

ex.en: Each player shook hands before the football match began.
ex.zh: 足球比赛开始前，每位球员都握了手。

ex.en: Young players benefit from coaches who value teamwork and personal development rather than winning alone.
ex.zh: 教练若重视团队合作和个人成长，而非一味追求胜利，年轻运动员就能从中受益。

col: team player｜善于团队合作的人
tip: 乐器演奏者可用“乐器名＋player”，如piano player。

senses.en: A machine that plays cassette tapes.

ex.en: The tape player is under the chair.
ex.zh: 录音机在椅子下面。

ex.en: Where is my tape player?
ex.zh: 我的录音机在哪里？

senses.en: a representation showing how something looks, works, or is organised
someone or something that provides a good example to follow
a person who displays clothes or poses for artists

ex.en: He built a model of a bridge from cardboard.
ex.zh: 他用硬纸板做了一座桥的模型。

ex.en: Researchers use a computer model to predict how rising temperatures may affect regional water supplies.
ex.zh: 研究人员利用计算机模型预测气温上升可能如何影响区域供水。

tip: model还可作动词，表示建模或当模特。

senses.en: a flying vehicle with wings and at least one engine
a flat surface extending in every direction
to make wood smooth using a special cutting tool

ex.en: Our plane landed just before the rain began.
ex.zh: 我们的飞机刚降落，雨就下起来了。

ex.en: Travelling by plane saves time, but its environmental impact should be considered when planning transport policy.
ex.zh: 乘飞机出行节省时间，但制定交通政策时应考虑其环境影响。

tip: by plane不加冠词；on a plane需加冠词。

senses.en: A small copy of a plane, often a toy or hobby model.

ex.en: I have a model plane at home.
ex.zh: 我家里有一架飞机模型。

ex.en: His model plane is white.
ex.zh: 他的飞机模型是白色的。

senses.en: Neatly arranged, with everything in its proper place.
To put things in order and make a place neat.

ex.en: Her desk stays tidy, even during the busiest weeks.
ex.zh: 即使在最忙的几周里，她的书桌也保持整洁。

ex.en: Keeping shared workplaces tidy can help employees find equipment quickly and create a more pleasant environment.
ex.zh: 保持共用工作场所整洁，有助于员工迅速找到设备，并营造更舒适的环境。

tip: tidy强调摆放整齐；clean强调没有污垢。

senses.en: Used to connect contrasting ideas or correct an earlier statement.
Except for someone or something.

ex.en: The bag looks small, but it holds everything I need.
ex.zh: 这个包看起来小，却装得下我需要的所有东西。

ex.en: Public transport can reduce traffic congestion, but services must be reliable enough to attract regular users.
ex.zh: 公共交通能缓解交通拥堵，但服务必须足够可靠，才能吸引经常乘坐的乘客。

col: not only ... but also ...｜不仅……而且……
tip: although与but通常不在同一句中成对使用。

senses.en: Belonging to or connected with the speaker and other people.

ex.en: Our kitchen smells wonderful when Dad bakes fresh bread.
ex.zh: 爸爸烤新鲜面包时，我们的厨房里香气四溢。

ex.en: Investing in public transport could improve our quality of life and reduce urban air pollution.
ex.zh: 投资公共交通可以提高我们的生活质量，并减少城市空气污染。

col: our daily lives｜我们的日常生活
our local community｜我们所在的社区
our shared future｜我们共同的未来
tip: our后须接名词；ours可独立使用。

senses.en: in, at, or to all places

ex.en: We looked everywhere, but the kitten was under the sofa.
ex.zh: 我们到处找，结果小猫就在沙发底下。

ex.en: Although digital services are expanding rapidly, reliable internet access is not yet available everywhere.
ex.zh: 尽管数字服务正在迅速扩展，可靠的互联网接入仍未覆盖所有地方。

tip: everywhere是副词，前面通常不加in或at。

senses.en: every time or on every occasion
throughout all time or for ever

ex.en: My neighbour always waves when she sees me.
ex.zh: 我的邻居每次看见我都会挥手。

ex.en: Higher levels of economic growth do not always lead to better living conditions for every citizen.
ex.zh: 更高水平的经济增长并不总能让每位公民的生活条件得到改善。

tip: 通常放实义动词前、be动词后；not always是并非总是。

senses.en: To perform an action or activity.
Used to form questions and negatives.
senses.zh: （构成疑问句和否定句的助动词）

ex.en: I do my homework every evening.
ex.zh: 我每天晚上做作业。

ex.en: What do you do on Sundays?
ex.zh: 你星期天做什么？

tip: 提问时 Do you ...? 回答 Yes, I do. / No, I don't.

senses.en: a sport involving hitting a ball over a net with rackets

ex.en: We play tennis at the park on Sundays.
ex.zh: 我们每逢周日都在公园打网球。

ex.en: Providing affordable tennis lessons can encourage young people to exercise regularly and develop greater physical coordination.
ex.zh: 提供价格实惠的网球课程，可以鼓励年轻人经常锻炼并提高身体协调能力。

tip: 说 play tennis，不加冠词；球拍用 racket。

senses.en: A round object used in games or shaped like one.
A formal social event where people dance.

ex.en: The dog chased the ball across the grass.
ex.zh: 那只狗追着球跑过草地。

ex.en: Simple ball games can help children develop coordination while encouraging cooperation and regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 简单的球类游戏能帮助儿童发展协调能力，同时促进合作和日常体育锻炼。

col: a ball of wool｜一团毛线
tip: 球类运动前通常不用冠词，如play football。

senses.en: A game hitting a light ball across a table with bats
To move or pass repeatedly back and forth

ex.en: We played ping-pong together while waiting for dinner.
ex.zh: 等晚饭时，我们一起打了乒乓球。

ex.en: Community centres can offer inexpensive activities such as ping-pong to encourage social interaction among older residents.
ex.zh: 社区中心可以提供乒乓球等花费不高的活动，鼓励老年居民进行社交。

tip: 较口语化；正式比赛和写作常用table tennis。

senses.en: A flying mammal usually active at night.
An object used to hit the ball in certain sports.
To hit or try to hit a ball with a bat.

ex.en: A bat flew above our garden at dusk.
ex.zh: 黄昏时，一只蝙蝠从我们花园上方飞过。

ex.en: Protecting bat habitats can benefit agriculture because many species feed on insects that damage crops.
ex.zh: 保护蝙蝠栖息地能使农业受益，因为许多蝙蝠以危害农作物的昆虫为食。

tip: 网球拍用racket，棒球棒和板球拍用bat。

senses.en: A game where two teams kick a ball into goals.

ex.en: We play soccer in the park every Saturday morning.
ex.zh: 我们每周六早上都在公园踢足球。

ex.en: Community soccer clubs provide affordable exercise and help young people develop teamwork skills outside the classroom.
ex.zh: 社区足球俱乐部提供费用低廉的锻炼机会，帮助年轻人在课堂之外培养团队协作能力。

tip: 英式英语通常称football，美式称soccer。

senses.en: The ball used in the game of soccer (football).

ex.en: I have a soccer ball.
ex.zh: 我有一个足球。

ex.en: Let's play with the soccer ball.
ex.zh: 我们一起玩这个足球吧。

tip: soccer 是美式英语说法，英式英语叫 football。

senses.en: A game of hitting a ball over a high net.

ex.en: We played volleyball on the beach until the sun set.
ex.zh: 我们在沙滩上打排球，一直打到日落。

ex.en: Team sports such as volleyball can help students develop communication skills while encouraging regular physical activity.
ex.zh: 排球等团队运动既能帮助学生培养沟通能力，也能鼓励他们定期锻炼。

tip: 指运动时不可数，play volleyball中不加冠词。

senses.en: a game where teams throw a ball through raised hoops
the large round ball used in this game

ex.en: We play basketball at the park after school.
ex.zh: 放学后，我们在公园打篮球。

ex.en: Team sports such as basketball help young people develop cooperation skills while improving their physical fitness.
ex.zh: 篮球等团队运动有助于年轻人培养协作能力，同时增强体质。

tip: play basketball不加冠词；指一个球用a basketball。

senses.en: Used informally to greet someone or attract their attention.

ex.en: Hey, you left your umbrella beside the door!
ex.zh: 喂，你把伞落在门边了！

ex.en: Informal greetings such as hey may be inappropriate when students first contact university staff by email.
ex.zh: 学生初次通过电子邮件联系大学教职员工时，使用hey这类非正式问候语可能不太合适。

tip: 适合熟人间打招呼；正式邮件避免使用。

senses.en: To allow someone to do something or something to happen.
To allow someone to use property in exchange for rent.

ex.en: Please let me know when you arrive home safely.
ex.zh: 你平安到家后请告诉我。

ex.en: Schools should let students explore different subjects before requiring them to choose a specialist pathway.
ex.zh: 学校应让学生先探索不同学科，再要求他们选择专业方向。

tip: let sb do sth中不加to；过去式、过去分词均为let。

senses.en: The speaker and others, as object.

ex.en: Please give it to us.
ex.zh: 请把它给我们。

ex.en: Let's go with us.
ex.zh: 跟我们一起走吧。

tip: we 是主格，us 是宾格。

senses.en: Short for 'let us': a suggestion for doing something together.
senses.zh: 让我们……吧（let us 的缩写，提议一起做某事）

ex.en: Let's play soccer!
ex.zh: 我们踢足球吧！

ex.en: Let's go to school.
ex.zh: 我们去上学吧。

tip: Let's + 动词原形，回答常用 Good idea! / Great!

senses.en: Used to suggest doing something together.
senses.zh: 让我们（提议一起做某事）

ex.en: Let us play basketball.
ex.zh: 让我们打篮球吧。

ex.en: Let us help you.
ex.zh: 让我们帮你吧。

tip: let us 的完整形式，缩写为 let's。

senses.en: To move from one place to another.
To leave a place.

ex.en: I go to school by bus.
ex.zh: 我坐公交车去上学。

ex.en: Let's go!
ex.zh: 我们走吧！

tip: go to + 地点；但 go home、go there 前面不加 to。

senses.en: The speaker and other people, as subject.

ex.en: We are students.
ex.zh: 我们是学生。

ex.en: We have a soccer ball.
ex.zh: 我们有一个足球。

senses.en: after the expected time or near the end of a period
after the expected time or towards a period's end
used before mentioning a person who has died

ex.en: I was late because my bicycle had a flat tyre.
ex.zh: 我迟到了，因为我的自行车轮胎没气了。

ex.en: Students who regularly stay up late may struggle to concentrate and perform well in morning classes.
ex.zh: 经常熬夜的学生在上午的课堂上可能难以集中注意力并取得良好表现。

tip: late作副词指迟、晚；lately指最近，不能混用。

senses.en: Third person singular form of 'have'.
senses.zh: 有（have 的第三人称单数形式）

ex.en: She has a tennis ball.
ex.zh: 她有一个网球。

ex.en: He has two brothers.
ex.zh: 他有两个哥哥。

tip: 主语是 he/she/it 时，「有」用 has：She has a book.

senses.en: To obtain or receive something.
To become a particular way.
To arrive at a place.

ex.en: I got a warm scarf for my birthday.
ex.zh: 我生日时收到了一条暖和的围巾。

ex.en: Students from low-income families may struggle to get the financial support they need to complete university courses.
ex.zh: 低收入家庭的学生可能难以获得完成大学课程所需的经济支持。

tip: 过去式got；美式过去分词也用gotten。

senses.en: Very good or enjoyable.
Very large in amount, size, or degree.
Highly important, admired, or successful.

ex.en: We had a great afternoon swimming in the lake.
ex.zh: 我们在湖里游泳，度过了一个愉快的下午。

ex.en: Access to reliable internet is of great importance for students living in remote areas.
ex.zh: 对于居住在偏远地区的学生来说，能够使用可靠的互联网至关重要。

tip: a great deal of后接不可数名词，表示大量。

senses.en: Enjoy an activity or take part in a game
Perform music or a role, or make a recording run
A story written for actors to perform

ex.en: The children played with wooden blocks on the floor.
ex.zh: 孩子们在地板上玩木制积木。

ex.en: Schools should provide safe outdoor spaces where children can play and develop essential social skills.
ex.zh: 学校应提供安全的户外空间，让孩子们玩耍并培养重要的社交技能。

col: play a role in｜在…中发挥作用
put on a play｜上演一部戏剧
tip: 球类前通常不加冠词；乐器前通常用the。

senses.en: something you hear
to seem a certain way when heard, or produce noise
sensible, reliable, or in good condition

ex.en: The sound of rain woke me before sunrise.
ex.zh: 天还没亮，雨声就把我吵醒了。

ex.en: Environmental policies should be based on sound scientific evidence rather than assumptions about public behaviour.
ex.zh: 环境政策应以可靠的科学证据为基础，而非对公众行为的假设。

tip: sound后接形容词；sound like后接名词。

senses.en: Making you want to pay attention or learn more.

ex.en: We found an interesting little museum near the station.
ex.zh: 我们在车站附近发现了一家有趣的小博物馆。

ex.en: The survey revealed an interesting connection between access to green spaces and residents' overall satisfaction with urban life.
ex.zh: 这项调查揭示了绿地可达性与居民对城市生活的总体满意度之间一种值得关注的联系。

col: an interesting finding｜值得关注的发现
find something interesting｜觉得某事有趣
tip: interesting形容事物引人兴趣，不等于funny好笑。

senses.en: Not interesting or exciting.

ex.en: The film was so boring that I fell asleep.
ex.zh: 这部电影太无聊了，我都睡着了。

ex.en: Students may find repetitive exercises boring unless teachers explain their purpose and introduce variety.
ex.zh: 如果教师不解释练习的目的并增加变化，学生可能会觉得重复练习很乏味。

col: find something boring｜觉得某事无聊
tip: boring指令人无聊；bored指人感到无聊。

senses.en: Enjoyment or pleasure from an activity or experience.
Enjoyable and entertaining.

ex.en: We had so much fun building sandcastles together yesterday.
ex.zh: 昨天我们一起堆沙堡，玩得特别开心。

ex.en: Making physical activity fun can encourage children to exercise regularly and develop healthier habits throughout their lives.
ex.zh: 让体育活动充满乐趣，可以鼓励儿童经常锻炼，并养成终身受益的健康习惯。

tip: fun作名词不可数；funny多指好笑的或奇怪的。

senses.en: Needing considerable effort or skill to do or understand.
Not easy to please, manage, or deal with.

ex.en: This heavy suitcase is difficult to carry upstairs.
ex.zh: 这个沉重的行李箱很难搬上楼。

ex.en: Many graduates find it difficult to secure stable employment without previous experience in their chosen field.
ex.zh: 许多毕业生发现，如果没有所选领域的工作经验，就很难找到稳定的工作。

col: a difficult customer｜难应付的顾客
tip: 常用find it difficult to do，勿把difficulty当形容词。

senses.en: making you feel calm and free from stress

ex.en: A warm bath is wonderfully relaxing after a busy day.
ex.zh: 忙碌一天后，泡个温水澡让人格外放松。

ex.en: Access to relaxing green spaces may improve mental wellbeing among residents of densely populated urban areas.
ex.zh: 能前往令人放松的绿地，可能有助于改善人口密集城区居民的心理健康。

tip: relaxing形容事物令人放松；relaxed形容人感到放松。

senses.en: Television: the device or programmes broadcast.

ex.en: I watch TV in the evening.
ex.zh: 我晚上看电视。

ex.en: There is a football game on TV.
ex.zh: 电视上有一场足球比赛。

tip: watch TV 中间不加 the。

senses.en: To watch television programmes.

ex.en: Let's watch TV after dinner.
ex.zh: 晚饭后我们看电视吧。

ex.en: He watches TV every evening.
ex.zh: 他每天晚上看电视。

tip: 第三人称单数是 watches TV。

senses.en: Exactly alike, or referring to one particular thing rather than another.
The very thing already mentioned, or something exactly like it.

ex.en: We take the same bus to school every morning.
ex.zh: 我们每天早上乘同一班公交车上学。

ex.en: Students from different backgrounds should have the same opportunities to access high-quality education and develop their talents.
ex.zh: 不同背景的学生应享有同样的机会，接受优质教育并发展自己的才能。

tip: 通常用the same；比较时用the same as。

senses.en: feel deep affection for someone or enjoy something very much
a strong feeling of affection or great enjoyment

ex.en: I love walking by the river after dinner.
ex.zh: 我很喜欢晚饭后沿着河边散步。

ex.en: Schools can develop children's love of reading by providing diverse books and regular library visits.
ex.zh: 学校可以通过提供多样化的图书和安排定期参观图书馆，培养孩子对阅读的热爱。

col: love of learning｜对学习的热爱
tip: love doing和love to do均可表示喜欢做某事。

senses.en: Accompanied by another person or thing.
Having or including a particular feature or thing.
Using a particular tool, material, or means.

ex.en: I cooked dinner with my sister last night.
ex.zh: 昨晚我和姐姐一起做了晚饭。

ex.en: Schools should work with local communities to provide children with safe spaces for outdoor activities.
ex.zh: 学校应与当地社区合作，为儿童提供安全的户外活动空间。

col: agree with someone｜同意某人的看法
with the help of｜在……的帮助下
tip: with后接名词或代词宾格，如with me。

senses.en: Physical activities involving skill, effort, and often competition
To wear or display something in a noticeable way

ex.en: Swimming is the only sport my sister really enjoys.
ex.zh: 游泳是我姐姐唯一真正喜欢的运动。

ex.en: Regular participation in sport can improve physical health and help young people develop teamwork skills.
ex.zh: 经常参加体育运动能改善身体健康，并帮助年轻人培养团队合作能力。

col: take part in sport｜参加体育运动
tip: 泛指体育时英式常用sport，美式常用sports。

senses.en: People or things already mentioned, as object.

ex.en: I like them very much.
ex.zh: 我非常喜欢他们。

ex.en: These books are for them.
ex.zh: 这些书是给他们的。

tip: they 是主格，them 是宾格。

senses.en: No more than; just.
With no others of the same kind.

ex.en: I only have one pen.
ex.zh: 我只有一支钢笔。

ex.en: He is the only child in the family.
ex.zh: 他是家里唯一的孩子。

senses.en: to enjoy something or feel positively about someone
similar to someone or something
used to introduce an example

ex.en: I like reading by the window on rainy afternoons.
ex.zh: 我喜欢在下雨的午后坐在窗边读书。

ex.en: Many residents like having green spaces nearby because they provide opportunities for exercise and relaxation.
ex.zh: 许多居民喜欢附近有绿地，因为绿地提供了锻炼和放松的机会。

col: feel like doing something｜想做某事
tip: would like to do 比 want to do 更礼貌。

senses.en: Not difficult and requiring little effort.
Relaxed and free from worry or pressure.

ex.en: This soup is easy to make with fresh vegetables.
ex.zh: 用新鲜蔬菜做这道汤很容易。

ex.en: Providing easy access to reliable health information can help people make better decisions about their lifestyles.
ex.zh: 让人们方便地获取可靠的健康信息，有助于他们作出更好的生活方式选择。

col: easy access to｜便于获取或到达……
tip: 常用easy to do；修饰动作通常用easily。

senses.en: later than an event or time
following the time when something happens
behind or following someone or something

ex.en: We usually take a short walk after dinner.
ex.zh: 我们通常在晚饭后散一小会儿步。

ex.en: After cities improve public transport, more residents may choose to leave their cars at home.
ex.zh: 城市改善公共交通后，更多居民可能会选择不开车出门。

tip: 介词后接名词或动名词；连词后接完整从句。

senses.en: A group learning together, or a lesson they attend.
A social group or category sharing particular characteristics.
To place someone or something in a particular category.

ex.en: Our class is learning how to grow vegetables.
ex.zh: 我们班正在学习如何种蔬菜。

ex.en: Smaller class sizes may allow teachers to give more individual attention to students with learning difficulties.
ex.zh: 较小的班级规模可能让教师给予学习有困难的学生更多个别关注。

tip: in class通常指在上课；in the class指在这个班里。

senses.en: Someone who studies in the same class as you.

ex.en: My classmate lent me a pencil before the lesson.
ex.zh: 上课前，我的同班同学借给我一支铅笔。

ex.en: Working with classmates on group projects can help students develop communication and problem-solving skills.
ex.zh: 与同班同学合作完成小组项目可以帮助学生培养沟通和解决问题的能力。

col: a former classmate｜以前的同班同学
help a classmate｜帮助同班同学
tip: classmate指同班同学，schoolmate指同校同学。

senses.en: a written statement of money owed for goods or services
a proposed law being considered by a lawmaking body
a piece of paper money, especially in American English

ex.en: We asked for the bill after finishing our lunch.
ex.zh: 吃完午饭后，我们请服务员拿来账单。

ex.en: The proposed bill would require companies to disclose more information about their impact on the environment.
ex.zh: 这项拟议法案将要求企业披露更多有关其环境影响的信息。

col: a dollar bill｜一张美元钞票
tip: bill是待审议的法案；通过并生效后才成为法律。

senses.en: A long curved fruit with soft flesh and usually yellow skin

ex.en: He peeled a banana and sliced it over his cereal.
ex.zh: 他剥了一根香蕉，切成片放在麦片上。

ex.en: Banana farming provides an important source of income for many families in tropical regions.
ex.zh: 香蕉种植为热带地区的许多家庭提供了重要收入来源。

col: a bunch of bananas｜一串香蕉
tip: 可数名词：一根香蕉是a banana。

senses.en: A sandwich with a cooked beef patty in a bun.

ex.en: I'd like a hamburger for lunch.
ex.zh: 午饭我想吃一个汉堡包。

ex.en: This hamburger is nice.
ex.zh: 这个汉堡包很好吃。

senses.en: a soft, juicy fruit often eaten as a vegetable

ex.en: She sliced a ripe tomato for her cheese sandwich.
ex.zh: 她切了一个熟番茄，放进奶酪三明治里。

ex.en: Growing tomatoes in community gardens can improve access to fresh food in urban neighbourhoods.
ex.zh: 在社区花园种植番茄，可以让城市居民更容易获得新鲜食物。

tip: 复数是tomatoes；英美发音的重读元音不同。

senses.en: A sweet frozen food made from cream or milk.

ex.en: I like ice-cream very much.
ex.zh: 我非常喜欢冰淇淋。

ex.en: An ice-cream is good on a hot day.
ex.zh: 热天吃个冰淇淋真不错。

tip: ice-cream 连写是英式习惯，美式常写 ice cream。

senses.en: a cold dish of vegetables or other mixed ingredients

ex.en: I added cucumber and tomatoes to the salad.
ex.zh: 我往沙拉里加了黄瓜和番茄。

ex.en: Offering fresh salad in school cafeterias can encourage children to eat a wider variety of vegetables.
ex.zh: 学校食堂供应新鲜沙拉，有助于鼓励儿童摄入更多种类的蔬菜。

tip: 可指一份沙拉，也可不可数地指沙拉这种食物。

senses.en: a soft red fruit with tiny seeds on its surface

ex.en: I picked a ripe strawberry and put it in my basket.
ex.zh: 我摘了一颗熟透的草莓，放进篮子里。

ex.en: Growing strawberries locally can reduce transport distances, although heated greenhouses may increase overall energy consumption.
ex.zh: 在本地种植草莓可以缩短运输距离，但加温温室可能增加总体能源消耗。

tip: 可数名词，复数为strawberries。

senses.en: A sweet, juicy fruit, often narrower at the top

ex.en: She sliced a ripe pear into her breakfast bowl.
ex.zh: 她把一个熟梨切成片，放进早餐碗里。

ex.en: Buying locally grown pears during their natural season may reduce the need for long-distance food transport.
ex.zh: 在自然成熟的季节购买本地种植的梨，可能减少长途食品运输的需求。

tip: pear与pair同音；一个梨用a pear。

senses.en: A white liquid female mammals produce to feed their young.
Take milk from an animal, especially a cow.

ex.en: I poured some cold milk over my cereal.
ex.zh: 我往麦片上倒了些冷牛奶。

ex.en: Milk provides calcium and protein, although people with certain dietary needs may choose suitable alternatives.
ex.zh: 牛奶提供钙和蛋白质，但有特殊饮食需求的人可以选择合适的替代品。

col: a glass of milk｜一杯牛奶
tip: milk通常不可数；说a glass of milk，不说a milk。

senses.en: a food made from flour and water, usually baked

ex.en: Fresh bread was cooling beside the kitchen window.
ex.zh: 刚出炉的面包放在厨房窗边晾凉。

ex.en: Choosing wholegrain bread instead of refined varieties can increase fibre intake and support a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 选择全谷物面包而非精制面包，可以增加膳食纤维摄入，有助于均衡饮食。

col: a loaf of bread｜一条面包
a slice of bread｜一片面包
tip: bread通常不可数；一片用a slice of bread。

senses.en: The yearly anniversary of the day someone was born.

ex.en: My sister baked a lemon cake for my birthday.
ex.zh: 姐姐为我的生日烤了一个柠檬蛋糕。

ex.en: Although birthday celebrations vary across cultures, they often provide opportunities for families to spend time together.
ex.zh: 虽然不同文化中的生日庆祝方式各异，但它们往往能让家人有机会相聚。

tip: 在某人生日当天用on，不用in或at。

senses.en: The main meal of the day, usually eaten in the evening.
A formal social occasion at which people eat a meal.

ex.en: Dinner is ready, so please bring the plates.
ex.zh: 晚饭做好了，请把盘子拿来。

ex.en: Sharing dinner regularly can strengthen family relationships by giving everyone an opportunity to discuss their daily experiences.
ex.zh: 经常共进晚餐能让每个人有机会交流日常经历，从而增进家庭关系。

tip: 日常说 have dinner，不加冠词；正式宴会可说 a dinner。

senses.en: a period of seven days
the days or hours normally spent working each week

ex.en: I borrowed this book from the library last week.
ex.zh: 我上周从图书馆借了这本书。

ex.en: A shorter working week could improve employee wellbeing, provided that workloads are reduced rather than compressed.
ex.zh: 缩短工作周可能改善员工的身心状况，前提是减少工作量，而非把工作集中完成。

tip: last/next/this week前不加介词。

senses.en: To consider something carefully in your mind.

ex.en: Think about the question carefully.
ex.zh: 仔细想想这个问题。

ex.en: Let's think about the plan.
ex.zh: 我们考虑一下这个计划吧。

senses.en: Things people or animals eat to live and grow.

ex.en: We packed enough food for a picnic by the lake.
ex.zh: 我们带了足够的食物，准备在湖边野餐。

ex.en: Reducing food waste at home can save money and lower the environmental impact of household consumption.
ex.zh: 减少家庭食物浪费既能省钱，也能降低家庭消费对环境的影响。

tip: 泛指食物时不可数；foods表示不同种类的食物。

senses.en: Feeling no doubt that something is true or correct.
Certain to happen or do something.
Used informally to agree or strongly confirm something.

ex.en: Are you sure you left your keys here?
ex.zh: 你确定把钥匙落在这里了吗？

ex.en: Governments must make sure that rural communities have reliable access to essential healthcare services.
ex.zh: 政府必须确保农村社区能够稳定地获得基本医疗服务。

tip: be sure of表确信；be sure to可表必然或叮嘱。

senses.en: Used to make a suggestion or ask an opinion.

ex.en: How about this watch?
ex.zh: 这块手表怎么样？

ex.en: I'm free. How about you?
ex.zh: 我有空。你呢？

tip: How about 和 What about 用法基本相同，后接名词或动名词。

senses.en: A flat food patty, often served inside a round bread roll

ex.en: I ordered a bean burger with salad for lunch.
ex.zh: 我午餐点了一个豆类汉堡配沙拉。

ex.en: Restaurants can reduce their environmental impact by offering plant-based burgers alongside traditional meat dishes.
ex.zh: 餐馆可以在供应传统肉类菜肴的同时提供植物基汉堡，以减少对环境的影响。

tip: burger也可指肉饼本身，并非都以牛肉制成。

senses.en: a plant or plant part eaten as food

ex.en: We bought fresh vegetables at the market this morning.
ex.zh: 我们今天早上在市场买了新鲜蔬菜。

ex.en: Schools can encourage healthier eating by serving a wider variety of vegetables at lunchtime.
ex.zh: 学校可以在午餐时供应更多种类的蔬菜，鼓励更健康的饮食。

tip: 通常为可数名词；泛指多种蔬菜用vegetables。

senses.en: Plant products containing seeds, often sweet and eaten as food.
The useful results of work or effort.
To produce fruit.

ex.en: She packed fresh fruit in my lunch box.
ex.zh: 她在我的午餐盒里放了新鲜水果。

ex.en: Making fresh fruit affordable could encourage healthier eating habits among families with limited incomes.
ex.zh: 让新鲜水果价格更亲民，可以鼓励低收入家庭养成更健康的饮食习惯。

col: the fruits of your labour｜劳动成果
tip: 泛指水果通常不可数；fruits可指种类或成果。

senses.en: Correct, true, or suitable for a particular purpose.
Something you are legally or morally entitled to.
On the side opposite to the left.

ex.en: You picked the right key to open the door.
ex.zh: 你选对了开门的钥匙。

ex.en: Every child has the right to receive an education, regardless of their family's financial circumstances.
ex.zh: 每个孩子都有受教育的权利，无论其家庭经济状况如何。

col: the right to education｜受教育权
make the right decision｜作出正确决定
tip: 表示权利用a right to；表示在右边用on the right。

senses.en: a round fruit with firm flesh and red or green skin

ex.en: I packed an apple and a sandwich for lunch.
ex.zh: 我装了一个苹果和一个三明治当午餐。

ex.en: Providing fresh fruit, such as apples, in schools may encourage children to develop healthier eating habits.
ex.zh: 在学校提供苹果等新鲜水果，可能有助于鼓励儿童养成更健康的饮食习惯。

tip: 可数名词；“一个苹果”用an apple。

senses.en: After that; next in time or order.

ex.en: We have breakfast, and then go to school.
ex.zh: 我们吃完早饭，然后去上学。

ex.en: First English, then math.
ex.zh: 先英语课，然后数学课。

senses.en: a rounded object laid by female birds and some other animals
a female reproductive cell that can develop after fertilisation

ex.en: She cracked an egg into the hot frying pan.
ex.zh: 她把一个鸡蛋打进了热煎锅。

ex.en: Eggs provide an affordable source of protein and can form part of a balanced diet.
ex.zh: 鸡蛋是价格实惠的蛋白质来源，可以成为均衡饮食的一部分。

tip: scrambled eggs指炒蛋；egg white指蛋清。

senses.en: A long, usually orange root vegetable.
A reward offered to encourage someone to do something.

ex.en: She sliced a carrot and added it to the soup.
ex.zh: 她把一根胡萝卜切片，放进汤里。

ex.en: Governments can use tax reductions as a carrot to encourage businesses to invest in renewable energy.
ex.zh: 政府可以用减税作为激励，鼓励企业投资可再生能源。

tip: 比喻奖励或诱因；carrot and stick指奖惩并用。
